_comment: Example parameter file for a MANUAL `az deployment group create --parameters @infra/main.parameters.json`. The deploy workflow (.github/workflows/deploy.yml) passes parameters inline, so CI does not read this file. Deploy order: infra/registry.bicep, then infra/postgres.bicep (plus its one-time SQL bootstrap), then this template. The repository default is one replica with no Redis (minReplicas 1, maxReplicas 1, provisionRedis false); more than one replica needs provisionRedis true, because the replicas share events, stream commands, the AI budget ledger, cache invalidation and rate limits only through Redis, and the app refuses to start with PAD_MAX_REPLICAS above 1 and no PAD_REDIS_URL. The deploy workflow takes these three from the repository variables PAD_MIN_REPLICAS, PAD_MAX_REPLICAS and PAD_PROVISION_REDIS (and scaleConcurrentRequests from PAD_SCALE_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS). See the header of infra/main.bicep and docs/architecture/operations.md, 'Running more than one replica'.

encryptionKey.value: <openssl rand -hex 32, DIFFERENT from authSecret; REQUIRED. Changing it later without listing the old value in encryptionKeyPrevious makes every stored credential unreadable; a deployment that ran without it lists the current authSecret there (docs/architecture/operations.md, Encryption keys)>

metricsToken.value: <openssl rand -hex 32; without it GET /metrics is public, because PAD_BEHIND_PROXY makes the private-IP allowlist vacuous>

parameters._email_comment: Without SMTP the app falls back to a log-only mailer: password-reset and email-verification links are written to Log Analytics instead of being delivered.
parameters._sso_comment: All three of issuer/clientId/redirectUrl are required together, or SSO stays off. Entra ID issuer: https://login.microsoftonline.com/{tenant-id}/v2.0
parameters._retention_comment: auditRetentionDays empty uses the app's cloud default of 400 days; "0" keeps everything forever.
parameters._ai_knobs_comment: Azure Foundry / knowledge-base operator knobs (see .env.example); the CI deploy (.github/workflows/deploy.yml) passes them from repository variables, not secrets — none is sensitive. aiAllowPrivateEgress needs the environment in a virtual network (infrastructureSubnetId).
parameters._network_comment: Private networking (docs/architecture/operations.md): infra/postgres.bicep's acaInfrastructureSubnetId output, from a deployment with privateAccess true. Empty keeps the environment off any network; an existing environment cannot join one (deploy a new one under a new appName).
